title: filter: grayscale() - Filters - Tailwind CSS
content_text: FILTERS filter: grayscale() Utilities for applying grayscale filters to an element. Class Styles grayscale filter: grayscale(100%); grayscale- filter: grayscale(%); grayscale-() filter: grayscale(var()); grayscale-[] filter: grayscale(); EXAMPLES Basic example Use utilities like grayscale and grayscale-75 to control the amount of grayscale effect applied to an element: grayscale-0 grayscale-25 grayscale-50 grayscale Using a custom value Use the grayscale-[] syntax to set the grayscale based on a completely custom value: For CSS variables, you can also use the grayscale-() syntax: This is just a shorthand for grayscale-[var()] that adds the var() function for you automatically. Responsive design Prefix a filter: grayscale() utility with a breakpoint variant like md: to only apply the utility at medium screen sizes and above: Learn more about using variants in the variants documentation. drop-shadow hue-rotate
